lede: Sunrise Auto Services is a car workshop in Defu Industrial Estate (Defu Lane). Its own website lists maintenance and servicing, diagnostics, gearbox repairs and overhauls and brake repairs.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention clear explanations with prices upfront, a waiting lounge, help moving an OBU display that blocked the view, and a quick fix for a badly vibrating car.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, sunriseauto.com.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
